# Unit 6 - Vertex Form Explorer {.unnumbered}

This widget lets you play around with quadratics in vertex form.

$$
f(x) = a(x - h)^2 + k
$$

This gives a parabola with vertex $(h, k)$ and scale factor $a$.

{{< include /assets/Unit_6/vertex_form-widget.html >}}

---

To learn more, take a look at [6.2 - Graphing Quadratics](/chapters/Unit_6/6.2_Graphing_Quadratics.qmd)
